sn34.10:1.5: One meditator is skilled in doing what’s conducive to immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.10:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in doing what’s conducive to it.
sn34.10:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in doing what’s conducive to it.
sn34.10:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in doing what’s conducive to it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
